atlas.name: Aethelgard Creature Atlas
atlas.classification_policy: D&D-inspired creature categories are reference scaffolding only. Aethelgard species, variants, ecology, names, behavior, and lore must remain original.
ecological_rules: Creatures emerging from the violet reality fissure are not Skull-Veil elves.
The fissure creatures should retain an immediately frightening identity and should not become harmless merely because the protagonists understand them.
Creature names must be distinct from faction nicknames.
Creature behavior should follow established anatomy, magic, habitat, and threat logic once canonized.

behavior: capable of coordinated emergence through reality tears
fissure_spawn_development.separation_rule: Never label these creatures Skull-Veil. Skull-Veil is an Elven faction nickname in the manuscript.

planned_catalogue.reference_scope: chromatic, metallic, gem, ancient and regional variants
reality-warped, psychic, subterranean and fissure-adjacent organisms
wild spirits, court fey, nature guardians and hostile tricksters
divine messengers, radiant guardians and ancient beings
necromantic, revenant, spectral and corpse-bound entities
elemental spirits and Flux-altered elemental life
Ley-Tech, ancient guardian, industrial and autonomous constructs
giant-kin cultures and ancient elemental lineages
magically altered predators and unnatural hybrids
sentient flora, root guardians and magical ecosystems
